title: 宾补：带 to 与省略 to

examples.en: The teacher asked us to be quiet.
I saw him enter the room.

guess.question: 同样是“宾语 + 动词”，为什么第一句有 to，第二句没有？

options.text: ask/tell 后面要带 to，感官动词（see/hear）后面要省略 to
options.feedback: 对！“让某人做”用 to do，“看见/听见某人做”用 do（不带 to）。
不对——长短不是判据，看前面的动词是什么。
不对——see / hear / make / let 后面加了 to 就是错的。

left.label: 带 to：ask / tell / want sb to do
left.formula: ask / tell / want / would like + sb + to do

anchor.en: The teacher asked us to be quiet.

left.focus: “要求、告诉、想要”某人去做某事

right.label: 省略 to：see / hear / make / let sb do
right.formula: see / hear / watch / notice + sb + do；make / let + sb + do

anchor.en: I saw him enter the room.

right.focus: 感官动词和使役动词后面接不带 to 的动词原形

contrast.diff: 看见、听见、让、使 → sb do（不带 to）；要求、告诉、想要 → sb to do。判断就看前面那个动词属于哪一类。

traps.wrong: I saw him to enter the room.
traps.right: I saw him enter the room.
traps.why: see / hear 这类感官动词后面要省略 to。

traps.wrong: The teacher asked us stop talking.
traps.right: The teacher asked us to stop talking.

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——记住分两组：看听让（do）／要求告诉想要（to do）。

check.stem: My mother told me ____ (clean) my room at once.

options.distractor: tell sb 后面接 to do

check.stem: I heard her ____ (sing) in the next room.
check.explanation: hear sb do sth，省略 to。

The teacher asked us stop talking.
The teacher asked us stopping talking.
